The '''Karak Wraith''' is the [[Wraith]] variant of the {{Weapon|Karak}} assault rifle, with higher damage, critical stats, [[status chance]], and magazine size.

==Characteristics==

* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.

{{Advantages|*Low recoil.|name=Karak Wraith}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Karak Wraith}}

{{WeaponComparison|Karak}}
{{WeaponComparison|Kuva Karak|header=n}}

==Acquisition==
Karak Wraith was introduced during the [[Operation: Tubemen of Regor]] [[event]], where players would need to complete a minimum of four regional battles in favor of one side more than the other, and [[Alad V]] was the victor of the conflict. Alad V had won the conflict in the PC and XB1 versions of the game, but not in the PS4. The weapon was fully built and came with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

The blueprint and parts were formerly a reward from the [[Sortie/ArchivedRewards|First and Third]] Seasons of [[Sortie]]s; they can now be found as an [[Invasion]] reward. All components can be [[Trade System|traded]], although players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 7 to acquire the blueprint.

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Trivia==
*Curiously, the Karak Wraith's UI icon appears to be missing its magazine and the remainder of the hanging strap.
*The Karak Wraith is the sixth [[Wraith]] weapon to be released.
*When the Karak Wraith has a quarter of its total magazine left, it will sound slightly higher approaching the end of the magazine.
*This weapon is wielded by the [[Lancer#Variants|Nightwatch Lancers]] during the Project Undermine [[Tactical Alert]], perhaps due to the similarity in appearance between Wraith and Nightwatch skins, and the fact that there is no Nightwatch skin for the Karak, {{Weapon|Hind}}, or {{Weapon|Grakata}}.
**This the second time an enemy is seen using an Event Reward weapon (following the [[Stalker]]'s use of the {{Weapon|Braton Vandal}} prior to the introduction of the {{Weapon|Dread}}).

'''Kinetic Ricochet ''' is a mod that allows shots from the {{Weapon|Tetra}}, {{Weapon|Prisma Tetra}}, and {{Weapon|Tenet Tetra}} to [[bounce]] and travel further. Shots will bounce off of enemies and terrain.

==Drop Locations==

==Notes==
*Can be used on the {{Weapon|Prisma Tetra}} and {{Weapon|Tenet Tetra}} variants as well.
**For the Tenet Tetra, this mod will '''not''' affect the grenade [[Alternate Fire]].
*Projectiles interact strangely with [[punch through]] effects - they will not bounce off of enemies, and will often stop after hitting terrain.
**It seems that when the projectile hits a surface it decides if it can penetrate the object or not, if it can't, it bounces off the surface. This process goes on as long as the projectile has not penetrated anything yet. The projectile will only [[punch through]] what it can penetrate, and after the first penetration, it works just like normal projectile with the bounce effect.
***Due to the bullet penetrating thin obstacles at first hit, it is recommended not to use [[punch through]] if you plan to shoot the floor or the walls to make full use the bounce effect as it will often penetrate the walls or floor and not stay in the space.
**In general, it is recommended not to use any [[punch through]] mods.
*The mod will reduce the range of the projectiles from infinite to 100 meters. Every time the projectile bounces, that range seems to be further decreased. After just two bounces, the projectile will fizzle out after traveling less than 32 meters from the initial firing position.

==Tips==
*Shots will not bounce if they are in flight for too long. It is easier to get maximum bounces using {{M|Terminal Velocity}} and other mods that increase flight speed.
*Shots can hit the same enemy multiple times. For best results, fire into narrow hallways and crowded areas.
*Works very well with {{A|Magnetize}}, allowing each projectile to hit the target all 6 times.

Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna or Father in the Necralisk.|In-Game Description}} {{Clr}} '''Kitguns''' are modular primary and secondary firearms. As modular weapons, Kitguns are formed from three different components that can be mixed and matched before assembly, allowing players to create different combinations of parts with the stats and abilities that they desire. Additionally, Kitguns can be given custom names when created to further personalize the weapon. Like [[Zaw]]s, gilded Kitguns can be further upgraded with [[Arcane Enhancement#Pax Arcanes|Pax Arcanes]] and [[Arcane Enhancement#Residual Arcanes|Residual Arcanes]]. [[Rude Zuud]] of [[Solaris United]] sells [[Corpus]]-like Kitgun parts, while [[Father]] of the [[Entrati]] has [[Infested]]-like Kitgun parts. ==Components== A Kitgun consists of three different components, the '''Chamber''', the '''Grip''', and the '''Loader'''. Each component is centered around a particular aspect of the weapon, and these components can each have various parts to choose from, which changes the type of functionality that the component provides. ===Chamber=== The '''Chamber''' represents the primary component of the Kitgun that forms its barrel, which determines the form of the weapon's unique damage properties ranging from large energy projectiles to beams, as well as its trigger type. These are the components that earn [[Mastery Rank]] points for the weapon. Note that the primary and secondary variants of each chamber share the same Mastery progression, so leveling both the primary and secondary variant of the chamber '''will not''' give more Mastery. -- Magazine Capacity
++ Reload Speed
+ Critical Chance
- Status Chance == Crafting == ===Building=== Before players can craft a Kitgun, they must first purchase the blueprints for the parts they desire from [[Rude Zuud]] or [[Father]], which is available for [[Standing]], after which these parts must then be constructed at the [[Foundry]]. Once the component parts have been crafted, players must return to Rude Zuud or Father and select the '''Build Kitgun''' option. Here, players must choose the crafted components they have available to form the weapon. Once a Chamber, Grip, and Loader are selected, the player will be shown a preview of the weapon's appearance, along with the weapon's stats. If the weapon is satisfactory, players can then proceed with the '''Build Weapon''' action, which will instantly craft the weapon for {{cc|4,000}}. Players can also use the Build Kitgun screen to preview builds of Kitgun components they do not yet own. A newly built Kitgun cannot be renamed, customized, [[Polarization|Polarized]], equipped with a [[Focus Lens]], have [[Arcane Enhancement#Kitgun Arcanes|Kitgun Arcanes]] installed, or earn Mastery Rank experience. However, they can be equipped with an [[Orokin Catalyst]]. Once built, a Kitgun cannot be disassembled to return its components parts. ===Gilding=== In order to fully unlock all of a Kitgun's features, players must '''gild''' their weapon. To gild a weapon, players must have a reputation rank of at least '''Doer''' with [[Solaris United]], and the desired Kitgun must first be leveled up to Rank 30. Afterwards, players must return to Rude Zuud or Father and select the ''Gild'' option under ''Other Services'', which will cost '''10 {{Resource|Shelter Debt-Bond}}s''' (Rude Zuud) or '''25 {{Resource|Father Token}}s''' (Father) and '''{{sc|5,000}}'''. Upon gilding the weapon, players will be asked to first add a [[Polarity]] to the weapon, and then finally give it a custom name. This process will reset the weapon's level back to Rank 0. A Gilded Kitgun will have all of the functionality available to other weapons. A Kitgun will only give [[Mastery Rank]] points once gilded. Visually, the Gilded Kitgun will have a modified appearance over a newly-built one. ===Kitgun Arcanes=== Gilded Kitguns can be further improved through the installation of [[Arcane Enhancement#Kitgun Arcanes|Kitgun Arcanes]], that grant special conditional abilities to the Kitgun. [[Arcane Enhancement#Pax|Pax arcanes]] can be bought from Rude Zuud once a player has achieved the rank of '''Old Mate''' with [[Solaris United]] while [[Arcane Enhancement#Residual|Residual arcanes]] can be obtained through [[Isolation Vault|Isolation Vaults]]. These can be installed simultaneously with [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary Weapon Arcanes|Secondary]]/[[Arcane Enhancement#Primary Weapon Arcanes|Primary]] arcanes. {{clr}} ==Stats== ===Secondary=== {{CustomCollapsible|Kitgun Secondary Build Table|StatsSecondary}} Catchmoon ={{#lsth:Catchmoon/Table|Secondary}} |-|Gaze ={{#lsth:Gaze/Table|Secondary}} |-|Rattleguts ={{#lsth:Rattleguts/Table|Secondary}} |-|Tombfinger ={{#lsth:Tombfinger/Table|Secondary}} |-|Sporelacer ={{#lsth:Sporelacer/Table|Secondary}} |-|Vermisplicer ={{#lsth:Vermisplicer/Table|Secondary}} {{CustomCollapsible/End}} ===Primary=== {{CustomCollapsible|Kitgun Primary Build Table|StatsPrimary}} Catchmoon ={{#lsth:Catchmoon/Table|Primary}} |-|Gaze ={{#lsth:Gaze/Table|Primary}} |-|Rattleguts ={{#lsth:Rattleguts/Table|Primary}} |-|Tombfinger ={{#lsth:Tombfinger/Table|Primary}} |-|Sporelacer ={{#lsth:Sporelacer/Table|Primary}} |-|Vermisplicer ={{#lsth:Vermisplicer/Table|Primary}} {{CustomCollapsible/End}} {{clr}} == Kitgun Riven Mods == *Veiled Kitgun [[Riven Mods]] can be acquired through most Riven sources **Veiled Riven Mods can be obtained from [[Acrithis]], [[Palladino]], and [[Enter Nihil's Oubliette|Nihil's Oubliette]] with a 3.5% chance to become a Veiled Kitgun Riven Mod. **Veiled Kitgun Riven Mods can be obtained from [[Sortie|Sorties]], [[Archon Hunt|Archon Hunts]], and [[The Circuit|Duviri Steel Path Circuit]] with a 1%, 1%, and 1.2% chance respectively. *Kitgun Riven mods for a specific chamber can be equipped on both the primary and secondary versions. Note that the riven disposition changes based on the type. By default, the stats on the riven mod will reflect the primary disposition. {| class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible" |+ !Grip !Type !Riven Disposition |- |{{Weapon|Tombfinger (Primary)}} |Primary |1.00x |- |{{Weapon|Tombfinger (Secondary)}} |Secondary |0.85x |- |{{Weapon|Catchmoon (Primary)}} |Primary |1.10x |- |{{Weapon|Catchmoon (Secondary)}} |Secondary |0.70x |- |{{Weapon|Rattleguts (Primary)}} |Primary |1.00x |- |{{Weapon|Rattleguts (Secondary)}} |Secondary |0.90x |- |{{Weapon|Gaze (Primary)}} |Primary |1.10x |- |{{Weapon|Gaze (Secondary)}} |Secondary |0.95x |- |{{Weapon|Sporelacer (Primary)}} |Primary |1.15x |- |{{Weapon|Sporelacer (Secondary)}} |Secondary |0.60x |- |{{Weapon|Vermisplicer (Primary)}} |Primary |0.90x |- |{{Weapon|Vermisplicer (Secondary)}} |Secondary |1.10x |} {{Ver/Lu|39.1}} == Notes == *Rude Zuud also sells fully assembled Gilded Kitguns on her '''Today's Special''' option for {{pc}}. The Chamber, Grip and Loader combinations on these weapons are randomized daily. *Kitguns are compatible with [[Deluxe Skins]]. *Kitguns have to be gilded to earn [[Mastery Rank]] points, with their progression tied to the weapon's Chamber alone. For example, if a player levels up a Gilded Kitgun crafted with the Catchmoon Chamber to 30, any future Kitguns forged using the Catchmoon Chamber will no longer provide Mastery regardless of what combination of Grips and Loaders they have. **As there are six Chambers currently available, the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Kitgun crafting is '''18,000'''. *Gilding a kitgun also gives the gun a polarity slot of the player's choice. *With '''6''' Chambers, '''10''' Grips, and '''20''' Loaders, there are currently a total of '''1,200 '''possible Kitgun combinations available. *Rank 30 Kitguns or Gilded Kitguns can be donated to Rude Zuud in exchange for Solaris United Standing. *Kitguns can equip [[Riven Mods]], with the Riven Mods generated tied to the weapon's Chamber, e.g. ''Catchmoon Exi-Gelitis''. **The same Riven Mod may be equipped on any Kitgun, including both Primary and Secondary Kitguns, as long as they share the same Chamber. *Custom names for Kitguns have a ''24'' character limit including spaces, and will not accept special characters like commas (,) or apostrophes ('), though hyphens ( - ) are accepted. **Names can also not include any profanities such as swear words. *A Kitgun's [[reload]] animation is determined by the Grip and Loader chosen. *Typing [Kitgun] in the in-game chat and selecting the Kitgun will let other players in the same chat channel see its bonuses. *Kitguns cannot be used in the [[Conclave]]. ==Tips== *The Chamber determines the type of projectile fired by the Kitgun, fire rate, trigger type, base damage, base critical chance, base status chance and magazine capacity. *The Grip modifies base damage, [[fire rate]], and the amount of [[recoil]]. Grips with higher base damage will have a slower fire rate with higher recoil, and vice-versa. **Although faster Grips have less recoil than slower Grips, faster Grips are more susceptible to bullet spread depending on the [[Accuracy]] characteristics of the Chamber. **In the case of [[Gaze]], which is a beam weapon, the maximum range of the beam will be modified instead of fire rate. Grips with higher damage will reduce the beam's total range, and vice-versa. *The Loader determines the base reload speed, and modifies critical chance, status chance and magazine capacity. There are 4 major types: **'''Quickest''' loaders have the shortest reload speed of '''0.9 seconds''' but give the lowest magazine capacity. **'''Fast''' loaders have a short reload speed of '''1.3 seconds''' and low magazine capacity. **'''High capacity''' loaders have a longer reload speed of '''1.7 seconds''' with a higher magazine capacity. **'''Maximum capacity''' loaders have the longest reload speed at '''2.1 seconds''' but offer the highest magazine capacity. *When Kitguns are equipped with the {{Arcane|Pax Charge}} Arcane, the base recharge delay is equal to base reload speed. ==Bugs== *Using the Vermisplicer chamber when under the effects of invisibility (such as Ivaras Prowl) will cause the tentacles to be completely invisible, making it difficult to track where they are For those players that have just completed the Second Dream and are looking to craft a more powerful Amp to help you into and beyond The New War - these changes are for you! Instead of upon Gilding, modular weapons will now have their full stats available upon ranking up to Level 30. Gilding your Modular weapon now serves the purpose of allowing it to earn Mastery and unlock customization. This allows players to have access to more powerful gear without needing to fully level and earn Standing for the respective Syndicates! {{ver|30.5}} *Players can now install an Orokin Catalyst onto ungilded Modular items **Being unable to install a Reactor or Catalyst onto an ungilded modular item significantly slowed down progression on new Modular items. So we have removed that restriction! {{ver|29.5.8}} *Removed the 25 Grandmother Token cost to Gild Items at Father and replaced with 25 Father Tokens as originally intended. This also makes it clear you don't double dip!'' {{ver|29.5}} ;NEW INFESTED KITGUNS Heart of Deimos brought forward the "Weapons Vendor" of the Entrati, Father, of whom we mentioned would bring Infested Kitguns - and here they are! Purchase these parts from Father and visit your friendly Rude Zuud in Fortuna to build! ;CHAMBERS: '''''Vermisplicer''''' Primary: Long-range proboscis attaches to a target and then splits off to attack up to five more enemies. Secondary: Three short-range proboscises fiercely latch onto targets and maul them. '''''Sporelacer''''' Primary: Launches spore-sacs that explode with toxic mist on each bounce. Automatic trigger. Secondary: Fires spore-sacs that rupture into three smaller toxic projectiles on impact. {{Top|Enemy|Sentient|Sentient|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add [[punch through|punch through]]. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.}} The '''Komorex''' is an [[Amalgam]] [[Sniper Rifle|sniper rifle]] produced by the {{Faction|Corpus}} that incorporates {{Faction|Sentient}} technology in its design. Featuring a large magazine, high [[status chance]], fast [[fire rate]], two unique [[zoom]] modes for reduced [[recoil]] on the lowest zoom or boosted {{D|Viral}} damage explosion at max zoom, and innate 100% [[Ammo#Increasing_Ammo_From_Pickups|Ammo Mutation]], but suffers from having the lowest base damage and second lowest [[critical chance]] of any sniper rifle. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *Innate 100% [[Ammo#Increasing_Ammo_From_Pickups|Ammo Mutation]] effect. *Two zoom modes: **First zoom has '''2.0x''' zoom distance, '''-50%''' [[recoil]], and '''2''' meter [[punch through]]. **Second zoom has '''3.5x''' zoom distance, '''+100%''' {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Puncture}}, {{D|Slash}}, adds a '''3.5''' meter explosion dealing '''106''' {{D|Viral}} damage, and '''-75%''' fire rate. ***Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. ***Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. ***Fire rate debuff can be disabled using {{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}}. ***Can benefit from {{M|Cautious Shot}}. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Tied with {{Weapon|Vectis Prime}} for the largest shot combo requirement of all sniper rifles. **Second zoom explosion does not affect combo counter. *Lowest zoom distance of all sniper rifles. *Extremely inaccurate when fired from the hip. *Projectiles have travel time. *Second zoom explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Second zoom explosion cannot [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]]. *Second zoom explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 60% from central impact. *Second zoom explosion cannot benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) despite being area of effect. }} ==Acquisition== The Komorex's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *The '''-75%''' fire rate from the 3.5x zoom bonus is additive with mods, making it significantly offset by mods such as {{M|Vile Acceleration}}, but also severely punished with only {{M|Critical Delay}} equipped. *The '''+100%''' damage from the 3.5x zoom bonus is '''not''' +100% to base damage, but more specifically grants the following: **'''+100%''' {{D|Impact}} **'''+100%''' {{D|Puncture}} **'''+100%''' {{D|Slash}} *The scope bonus is therefore additive with physical and elemental mods such as {{M|Fanged Fusillade}}. *[[Punch through]] causes the 3.5x zoom explosion to only occur on the '''last''' target or surface it cannot penetrate. This breaks the norm where explosions usually explode on their first hit surface, and even disable punch-through entirely for the projectile. *Modded ammo mutation has no additional effect due to Komorex's 100% innate ammo mutation. It also cannot equip {{M|Sniper Ammo Mutation}} or {{M|Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation}}. {| class="wikitable" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:center;border:1px solid black;width:80%;font-size:12px;" |- ! scope="col" |Combo Counter Bonus Tier ! scope="col" |Total Base Damage Multiplier ! scope="col" |Minimum Consecutive Hits Required |- |1 || 1.5x || 5 |- |2 || 2.0x || 15 |- |3 || 2.5x || 45 |- |4 || 3.0x || 135 |- |5 || 3.5x || 405 |- |6 || 4.0x || 1215 |- |7 || 4.5x || 3645 |- |8 || 5.0x || 10935 |} ==Tips== *The innate {{D|Viral}} damage added on the max zoom option can allow it to more quickly deal with higher level [[Grineer]] and [[Corpus]] enemies, by modding the weapon with {{D|Corrosive}} or {{D|Toxin}} damage respectively. This will allow the viral damage to scale faster against [[armor|armored]] enemies, and decimate Corpus through [[shield|shields]]. *The Komorex can fire 3.5x shots slightly faster if the user unscopes and rescopes between each shot, letting firing cycle finish using the base fire rate value. Note that Komorex's fire rate is '''hard-capped''' around a value of {{text||8.0|hover=Fire rate caps are not well documented or understood. This value was measured at 60 FPS using a free-spinning scrollwheel at hundreds of inputs per second.}}, slightly below the typical semi-auto fire rate limit of 10. *Players may opt to install {{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}} as the mod's negation of any changes to the weapon's [[Fire Rate]] also applies to the reduction when adjusting to the 3.5x zoom level. Knowing this, players may also opt to install {{M|Critical Delay}}. **As the explosion at the 3.5x zoom level only applies to the last target penetrated via [[Punch Through]], keeping {{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}} unranked may be considered to maximize explosion damage, as the fire rate lock is the same at all mod ranks. ==Trivia== *The Komorex's name may be a portmanteau of the words ''[https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/komo#Hawaiian Komo]'' (Hawaiian word for "enter", "go into", and "penetrate") and ''[https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rex#Latin Rex]'' (Latin word for "king"). *Alternatively, "Komorex" could be a portmanteau of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komodo_dragon Komodo dragon] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyrannosaurus tyrannosaurus rex]. This is because a side view of the weapon has a faint resemblance to the profile of a reptilian head with jaws agape. *The Komorex and {{Weapon|Cyanex}} are the only two [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab Research]] weapons with a 12 hour build time. *Komorex has a unique reload animation where the Warframe grips the barrel and holds the gun vertically while folding the rod to eject the magazine, then holds the weapon at its base and adds a new clip which causes the gun to twirl twice. *Komorex used to have a Damage Multiplier that counted towards all status damage, including {{D|Slash|Bleed}} and {{D|Gas|Gas Cloud}}, as a multiplier unique from sources such as {{WF|Ash}}'s passive and faction damage such as {{A|Roar}}. Testing during [[Update 39]] indicates that the multiplier no longer exists. ==Media== File:The-Jovian-Concord-Komorex.jpg|Excalibur with Komorex File:Nikita-leshakov-komorex-lowpoly.jpg File:Nikita-leshakov-komorex-highpoly.jpg Komorex 3.png Komorex 2.png Komorex 1.png|Komorex as shown in the Arsenal {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|JdA-WkY2Bj0|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|1gGglp63PJI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|uuSoGrvlpbM|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} ;SEMI-AUTOMATIC WEAPON CHANGES While reviewing the stats of some weapons with a semi-automatic mode, we noticed that certain weapons had an unsustainably high fire rate for most players. We adjusted the stats of the following semi-automatic weapons whose maximum potential was only being reached with the use of macros (to learn more about third-party use in Warframe visit our [https://digitalextremes.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030014351-Third-Party-Software-and-You support article]). Since not everyone is an avid macro user (within the boundaries allowed), '''we lowered fire rates to a more humanly achievable level and improved their damage or reload stats to compensate.''' '''Komorex''' *Reduced fire rate from 6 to 5. *Increased damage from 87 to 97. *Increased radial damage from 33 to 53. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Komorex ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|31.6}} *Updated the muzzle flash position on the Komorex. {{ver|31.5}} *Fixed Sniper Rifles with multishot projectiles (Komorex) behaving differently than hitscan Sniper Rifles and only counting bullets that cause damage for combo counting. **Essentially, fixed projectile-based rifles counting every bullet individually for shot-combo mechanics when it comes to hits and misses. They now use the same rules as hitscan rifles which give you a combo stack for every bullet in your shot regardless of whether that bullet causes damage or not. {{ver|29.5}} *Fixed Xaku’s Xata’s Whisper sometimes not applying its damage buff or Void Status Effect when using the Komorex. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Komorex: 40% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|25.7}} *Fixed inability to equip the Terminal Velocity Mod on the Komorex. {{ver|25.0.8}} *Fixed the Komorex light FX being too intense. {{ver|25.0.5}} *Fixed the Komorex’s Energy color persisting as default. {{ver|25.0}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|24.5}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Cyanex}}, the secondary counterpart to this weapon. {{ResearchNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Komorex]] [[Category:Update 25]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Research]] [[Category:Sentient Weapons]] [[Category:Sentient]] [[Category:Self Interrupt Weapons]] [[Category:Viral Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Passives]] [[uk:Коморекс]]
